description.content: Updates a shipment object in preparation for shipping the order. A shipment represents the specific order lines that will be shipped together and plays a central role in the fulfillment process. All shipment fields can be updated except the order line IDs, it is not allowed to add or remove order lines from an existing shipment

variable.description: (Required) To identify a merchant for which this operation is carried out.

(Required) The identifier of the shipment for which updates are being requested.
